findings.title: Deleting the cache does not refresh the cache-status query
findings.body: The delete mutation only calls the optional `onSuccess` callback. Unlike the disconnect mutation, it never invalidates `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`, which is the query supplying `cacheUpdatedAt`. Consumers that do not provide an `onChanged` callback that explicitly refetches will continue to show the old "Last updated" value and delete action after the server has deleted the rows; this is especially persistent because the query disables refetch-on-window-focus. Invalidate or refetch `connectedCalendars` when the deletion settles.

findings.title: Legacy cache entries are stamped with the migration time rather than their update time
findings.body: Adding this required column with `DEFAULT NOW()` gives every pre-existing CalendarCache row the time the migration runs. The new status query takes the maximum of this field and the UI presents it as "Last updated", so existing cache data will be reported as freshly updated at deployment even if it was fetched much earlier. Backfill from an appropriate historical value (or treat legacy rows as having unknown status) instead of presenting the schema-migration timestamp as cache freshness.

findings.title: The cron development command executes an unpinned undeclared package
findings.body: `tsx` is not declared in this package's dependencies or devDependencies, and `npx tsx` may download and execute the currently published version at command time (or prompt/fail in offline or noninteractive environments). This bypasses the repository lockfile and makes `dev:cron` nondeterministic. Add and pin `tsx` as a development dependency and invoke it through Yarn/the package binary.

findings.title: Webhook setup failures exit successfully
findings.body: `cleanup` always exits with status 0, but it is also called when Tunnelmole is rate-limited or no tunnel URL can be extracted. As a result, an automated setup/test invocation reports success even though `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL` was not configured and subsequent webhook testing cannot work. Preserve a nonzero exit code for error paths.
